My Cat Likes Boxes: Mimi is a fat white cat. She has a soft bed, but she never sleeps in it. She likes boxes best.
Last week, Mum buys a new pair of shoes. Mimi jumps into the shoe box at once. She sleeps there for two days.
Today, a big box comes to our home. There is a lamp in it. Mimi is very excited. Now the big box is her new house. Poor lamp sits on the floor.
